prompt: Close-up of a whole family-style batch of hearty German mixed-meat and vegetable stew for four, still in its large cooking pot, with abundant broth and clearly visible solids. The largest solid share is mixed soup vegetables: orange carrot rounds and chunks, pale ivory celery pieces and tender white-and-pale-green leek rings, all intact after brief cooking. Equal modest amounts of dark-brown beef and opaque grey-beige pork cubes, plus a smaller share of pale-tan veal, sit among a modest amount of cream-yellow, just-tender peeled potato cubes and collapsed pale-gold onion strips. Beef shows soft seared patches from brief browning; all meats look fully cooked, moist and tender. Everything is surrounded and lightly coated by generous, thin amber-brown meat broth, with a delicate melted-fat sheen and tiny marjoram and black-pepper flecks. Finely chopped fresh parsley is lightly scattered over the surface. Served family-style in a pale cream enamel pot, with a plain metal ladle resting at one side and the solids naturally mixed throughout. The pot fills nearly the entire square frame, its rim cropped, on a clean unmarked warm light-wood surface. A camera angle of about 65 degrees, bright soft natural daylight, crisp moist detail, true vegetable colours and a wisp of steam complete the calm, appetising scene.

recipe_instructions.instruction: Zwiebeln abziehen, in Streifen schneiden. Diese in einem großen Topf im Fett andünsten. Alle Fleischsorten evtl. kleiner würfeln. Rindergulasch, zufügen, kurz mitbraten. Brühe und Majoran zufügen. Ca. 40 Min. zugedeckt köcheln. Dann Schweine- und Kalbfleisch zufügen. Das Ganze ca. weitere 40 Min. köcheln.

Kartoffeln schälen, in Würfel schneiden. Mit dem unaufgetauten Suppengemüse zufügen. Alles ca. weitere 10 Min. garen. Den Eintopf mit Salz, frisch gemahlenem Pfeffer würzen und mit fein geschnittener Petersilie bestreut servieren.
